business_profile.business_summary: A service-oriented business managing service calls for approximately 10 staff members, handling AC service requests, staff assignments, and automated reporting to clients.

current_processes.current_state: Service requests for AC servicing are managed manually or through a non-automated system, requiring human intervention to assign staff.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual assignment of staff to service requests and lack of automated dispatching to the nearest available technician.
current_processes.evidence: Client states: 'If their AC needs servicing now, when you put a request for service, which is nearby... Assign the staff. That is, assign them to go to their service there.'

current_processes.current_state: Staff are assigned to service requests manually, with no automated logic for workload balancing or secondary staff assignment.
current_processes.pain_point: If a primary staff member has a high workload or skips a service, a manual process is required to assign the next nearest staff, leading to delays and negative reviews.
current_processes.evidence: Client states: 'Now, if a staff is assigned, and if they have more workload, there is an option to automatically assign another staff.'

current_processes.current_state: Service reports are generated manually and sent to clients via WhatsApp and email.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual generation and sending of reports to clients, which is time-consuming and prone to human error.
current_processes.evidence: Client states: 'Generate it and keep the option to go to WhatsApp and email automatically.'

current_processes.current_state: Staff go to service sites and take photos manually, with no automated upload or integration.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual process of taking and uploading photos of service sites, which is time-consuming and prone to loss of data.
current_processes.evidence: Client states: 'The option to go to each site and take a photo of it and upload it.'

current_processes.current_state: Daily chat and daily start-up processes are managed manually for staff.
current_processes.pain_point: Manual daily chat and start-up processes for staff, which is time-consuming and prone to human error.
current_processes.evidence: Client states: 'Daily start. Admin. The mail will go automatically daily.'

opportunities.current_cost_driver: Manual assignment of staff to service requests, leading to delays and inefficiencies.
opportunities.current_state: Service requests are managed manually, with no automated logic for assigning the nearest staff.
opportunities.automation_opportunity: Implement an automated system to assign the nearest staff member to a service request, and automatically assign a secondary staff member if the primary has a high workload.
opportunities.metric: Time saved per service request assignment
